           has reached out to the victims' attorneys to advise them of the hearing and the opportunity
           for them to be heard. FBI Victim Services Division (VSD) reached out to those.victims not
           represented to advise the same. SDNY has offered to fund the travel of any of the victims •

        o Digital Evidence:



                                                                                                 EFTA01699578
               •A search warrant for the digital evidence seized from Epstein's property in the USVI
               is expected to be sworn out sometime next week in the SDNY. The items have been
               processed through the evidence control system, but they cannot be processed by
               CART until the warrant is obtained.
           • CART has completed processing the items seized from Epstein's residence in
               Manhattan (with the exception of the devices that were encrypted) and is currently in
               the piocess of making them available for the case agents to review. CART has
               separated all documents, emails, and text files so they can be reviewed according to
               the taint procedures setup by SDNY.
           • CART is in the process of exporting all documents, emails, and text files to an external
               storage so they can be imported into Relativity, a system that SDNY insists on using.
               CART has advised this will be an extremely time consuming process and that will not
               be completed until mid-September. SDNY has insisted the Relativity system be used
                to facilitate the taint review for privileged communications and is willing to wait.
